messages.subject: bquote/expression in legend
parts:
I'm a little stuck with using bquote() or expression() to format legend labels. Data to reproduce can be found at https://gist.github.com/3286475. Figure generated from these data is attached. 

The plot currently displays total count of email alerts for each year above the bars for that year. I'd like to modify the legend for this figure to display the total number of email alerts for each class, with a format like: Country (n = 39). I've tried using bquote and expression to format these, but without success. In most cases (especially using bquote), the (n = x) part is not displayed.

Any thoughts/suggestions?

Thanks,
-Matt
